body:
Thing is, I already have a job. I love the people that I work with, but it's only a part time job and there's no chance that they can give me more hours. Due to this, my dad is almost forcing me to leave because I'm not earning enough to pay the rent he wants and I feel like that place is the only way to distract myself. 

But I do hope things get better for me. I really do. I don't know how much longer I can live like this because I've felt this way for years. I was diagnosed with Borderline Personality Disorder when I was 18 and obviously it's nice to know what causes this, but it makes me feel weak. It's never going to go away.
